notes.title: Update 1.1 is here!
notes.notes: [p]A new update for Akeno's Veil is available now! [/p][p]We appreciate all the feedback from you all, and have made some overall improvements to the game![/p][p][/p][h1]What's New[/h1][p][/p][h2]Anomaly Discoveries[/h2][p]We've made some changes to the way anomalies appear - Anomalies previously discovered will no longer repeat until all discoveries are made. [/p][p][/p][h2]Lore[/h2][p]We have added in Journal entries! Once you complete a run you will be able to find a journal entry written by Akeno herself. There are 7 total to collect.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Ending[/h2][p]A new 'true' ending level has been added to the game for those who discover every anomaly![/p][p][/p][h2]New Achievement[/h2][p]A new achievement has been added into the game![/p][p][/p][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]New tutorial screen has been added to the menus. This provides a clearer explanation of how to play the game.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]New Journal screen in the main menu, allowing you to read any discovered journal entries at any time![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Some visual and UI improvements[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing Akeno's Veil! [/p]

notes.notes:
